## Deferred this round — **serial behind #18881**, and the fold-or-serial question answered explicitly

<sub>`domain:services` seat (#6021) · `session_019hBqDVrwbijUCoK9qsss2E` · R1 · written 2026-09-18T21:47Z. ⛔ Report-only: no label written, no claim taken, this card keeps `pm:queue` and stays dispatchable. Board readings taken at this fire.</sub>

### Why this is written now rather than when the card is picked up

This card and **#18881** are both p1, both `pm:queue`, and both land in `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`. That is a shared hot file between two queued cards, so the protocol requires this seat to answer **fold or serial** out loud rather than let a default happen. #18881 was dispatched this fire; this card was not. The reasoning is recorded here so the next seat inherits a decision, ⛔ not a silence.

### Fold-or-serial — **SERIAL**, and two of the five gates fail

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| ① same defect shape, same repair | ⛔ **FAILS.** #18881 is a **region-containment** defect: a node inside `loop` / `parallel` / `try_catch` durably suspends and the run reports success with nothing run. This card is a **resume-leg rollup** defect: a child that pauses and *then refuses* is either lost fail-open (delegated resume) or strands its parent in `paused` (up-bubble). Same file, same subsystem — ⛔ **not the same defect and not the same repair.** Same keyword is ⛔ not gate ①. |
| ② same package / region | ✅ passes — both `service-automation`, both `engine.ts`. |
| ③ every member already ruled or graded | ⛔ **FAILS for this card.** #18881 carries a maintainer ruling (batch #153 item 1, ruling D on #15646). This card is graded p1/Bug by triage but the card itself says verbatim 「⛔ It does **not** prescribe the fix」 and names the mechanism choice as 「a design question that touches the engine's resume machinery」. |
| ④ each member independently checkable | ✅ passes — the card names two legs, each with its own measured signature. |
| ⑤ exclusion list named | ✅ this comment is it. |

⇒ **Two independent gate failures. ⛔ Not foldable.** They run serial, #18881 first.

### 🔴 The re-pricing question the next dispatch must answer BEFORE this card goes out

⛔ Do not dispatch this card on the estimate that stands today. When #18881's PR lands, its dev's report must be read against this card with the mandatory question:

> **Does #18881's change make this card simpler, harder, unnecessary, or leave it unaffected?**

This is not a formality here — #18881 adds a **named structured failure** when a contained node durably suspends. If that failure fires on the shape this card's probe drives, part of this card may already be closed by it. ⭐ **The seat's own guess is that it does NOT** — this card's probe is `subflow` → pausing node → refusing `end`, which need not sit inside a structured region at all — **but that is a guess, ⛔ not a reading**, and it is recorded here as a falsifiable assumption rather than a premise.

### Readings this seat took at 2026-09-18T21:40Z that this card should not have to re-take

- **#18112 is `closed`/`completed`.** The card warns it 「may intersect the region/rethrow territory that #18112's ruling deliberately left closed (option B not implemented, no container taught to rethrow)」 — ⇒ that ruling is closed and must be **read before** this card is dispatched, exactly as the card asks.
- **#15646 is still `open`**, and its **spec half landed** as `78436637` (#18688) on `origin/main`.
- The synchronous-leg fix this card builds on, **#18110/#18555 / PR #18706**, is merged as `5762eaf7`.
- Triage's standing instruction on this card, verbatim: 「⛔ 不要把它折进 PR #18706 …… **另起一张 PR,并让两条腿各有一条能变红的钉**」 ⇒ **two legs, two pins.** A delivery that reddens only one leg is incomplete on its face.

### 🔴 Re-pricing against the card that was blocking it — the mandatory question, answered from measurement

> **Does #18881's change make this card simpler, harder, unnecessary, or leave it unaffected?**

⭐ **Unaffected.** ⛔ Not a guess this time — when this card was deferred, this seat wrote that its probe 「need not sit inside a structured region at all」 and explicitly marked that **a guess, not a reading**. It is now measured on `origin/main` after #19140 landed:

| probe | reading |
|---|---|
| `isRegionSuspensionRefusal` call sites in `engine.ts` | **3** — the import (`:214`), the one-refusal-one-failure suppression (`:9528`), and a re-throw (`:10111`) |
| …of those, any on the **resume** or **up-bubble** path | **0** |
| `bubbleToParent` sites | **9** — still called on the completion path (`:6689`), defined at `:7067`; the refusal arm's structure is unchanged |
| negative control (bogus token) | **0** |

⇒ #18881 fires inside `runRegion` / `executeNode`. **Neither of this card's two legs is touched**, so its cost, its shape and its two-pin acceptance all stand as filed. ⛔ The estimate is ⛔ not carried over from filing time — it is re-taken here.

### ⚠️ One NEW adjacency #19140 created — a question for the dev, ⛔ not a finding and ⛔ not a fence

`engine.ts:10111` now re-throws on `isRegionSuspensionRefusal`. A run that **resumes into** a structured region can now meet that error type on a path this card is rewriting. ⇒ **check whether the resume legs need to handle it**, and say what you found. This seat did ⛔ not establish that they do.

### Standing constraints carried from the card and its triage

- Triage's instruction, verbatim: 「⛔ 不要把它折进 PR #18706 …… **另起一张 PR,并让两条腿各有一条能变红的钉**」 ⇒ **two legs, two pins.** A delivery that reddens only one leg is incomplete on its face.
- **#18112 is `closed`/`completed`** (measured 2026-09-18T21:40Z). The card warns it 「may intersect the region/rethrow territory that #18112's ruling deliberately left closed」 ⇒ read that ruling **before** choosing a mechanism.
- The synchronous leg this card builds on (#18110/#18555, PR #18706) is merged as `5762eaf7`.
